title: Legacy Application Migration to Azure Virtual Machines
business: Enterprises maintaining legacy monolithic applications requiring specific OS-level configurations.
problem: On-premises hardware lifecycle expiration and lack of physical space for server maintenance.
solution: Azure Virtual Machines provide a flexible IaaS environment to lift-and-shift legacy workloads, allowing for selectable sizes, disks, and networking configurations that mirror existing infrastructure requirements.
steps: Assess existing on-premises server resource requirements including CPU, RAM, and storage IOPS.
Select an appropriate Azure Virtual Machine size that matches the identified performance profile.
Configure virtual network interfaces and subnets to maintain existing connectivity patterns.
Attach managed disks to the virtual machine to host the operating system and application data.
Deploy the virtual machine using the Azure portal or CLI to initialize the environment.
outcome: Successful migration of legacy applications to a managed cloud environment with preserved configuration parity.
limitation: Virtual machines require manual operating system patching and maintenance, which can be verified by checking the OS update status and system logs.

questions.question: In Legacy Application Migration to Azure Virtual Machines, what is the primary benefit of using this technology for legacy workloads?
options: It provides a flexible IaaS environment to lift-and-shift legacy workloads.
It automatically refactors monolithic code into serverless functions.
It eliminates the need for any operating system configuration.
It replaces all physical hardware with containerized microservices.
questions.explanation: The scenario identifies that Azure Virtual Machines allow for lifting and shifting legacy applications by providing configurable infrastructure.
questions.evidence: Azure Virtual Machines provide a flexible IaaS environment to lift-and-shift legacy workloads, allowing for selectable sizes, disks, and networking configurations that mirror existing infrastructure requirements.

questions.question: In Legacy Application Migration to Azure Virtual Machines, what is a key operational limitation of the solution?
options: The inability to select different disk types.
The requirement for manual operating system patching and maintenance.
The lack of networking configuration options.
The inability to choose virtual machine sizes.
questions.explanation: Virtual machines are IaaS, meaning the user retains responsibility for the guest OS management, unlike PaaS offerings.
questions.evidence: Virtual machines require manual operating system patching and maintenance, which can be verified by checking the OS update status and system logs.
